info.name: Ludo.ai Generate a game sound effect

items.docs: Generate game sound effects from text descriptions. Supports configurable duration from 0 to 10 seconds where 0 uses automatic duration. Costs 3 credits per sound effect.
Generate background music and themes from text descriptions. Supports optional lyrics for vocal tracks. Costs 3 credits per track.

info.name: Ludo.ai Generate a unique character voice

items.docs: Generate unique character voices by describing the character and providing text to speak. Supports human and non-human voice types. Maximum 200 characters of text. Costs 3 credits per voice.

info.name: Ludo.ai Clone a voice from an audio sample

items.docs: Generate text-to-speech audio by cloning a voice from a provided audio sample. Maximum 1000 characters of text. Costs 3 credits per generation.

info.name: Ludo.ai Generate speech using a preset voice

items.docs: Generate text-to-speech audio using preset voice characters with optional emotion and language settings. Maximum 1000 characters of text. Costs 3 credits per generation.
